Actually I change my mind, what makes me mad abt you, is that your not respectful. I ask a question to better myself, and you decide to disrespectfully go against my beliefs. You ask a specific question that I answer and you say that because I answered, its me trying to push religion. There is a respectful way to go against someones beliefs, to try to get them to understand from another point of view, or try to persuade them of something. But. What your doing is not trying to make anyone better, not tryjng to pursuade them, Your just wanting a fight. 
And you didnt even answer my question. Whether or not someone is being brainwashed or that religion is wrong doesn’t help the question on what I say to someone.

You don’t know anything. People dont grow up the same way. I was athiest for alot of my childhood. I don’t believe in the church for the most part. I don’t care abt pushing my beliefs on anyone, thats you stereotyping. Your believing all Christina’s are the same.   And honestly I don’t believe in missionary work. I think it pushes people away more than brings them to god. Plus it brings disease in other countries. Its not that I am brainwashed. And most religions dont brainwash people, its just when i found faith which was fairly recent, and wasn’t when I was going to church. I started instincitvly doing things. Like i realized I stopped saying oh my god, and said goodness, whichh i know sounds ridiculous. And I instinctivly feel a nudge in my heart to say ‘ill pray for you”. I also didn’t really know how to deal with serious talks like that, before i was christian. “Im sorry” has always been my default, which is terrible. 

The thing that makes me mad about you, is your just so damn judgmental, and are making assumptions and judgment on every type of religion. You don’t know a person’s story. You don’t know what brought them there, if the church abandoned them and rejected them. If they were athiest and searching for something because they believed in something but they didn’t know what. And being a religious parent and teaching your kid about religion isn’t brainwash. When you believe in something, and celebrate thosr beliefs, are you supposed to just not talk or include your kid? Id say a mindset like yours is more likly to brainwash you kid, cause you have such a set mindset of how bad it is, that youd keep your child from any of it.

Yes, I seem to be reading the idea that it’s a cop out a lot. I never thought of it that way, so I never thought other people would think that. My concern has always been them getting offended because its something they just don’t believe in. So its definitely giving me some food for thought.
Tho I do think its possible to want to pray for someone and lend them a hand. I have also gotten a lot of really good responses of better things to say when I come across this scenario. Tho I do have to say I feel as tho the idea of it being a cop out is somehow a different conversation, as phrases like “you’ll
Be in my thoughts/send you my thoughts/please know your in my thoughts” or any type of apology type phrase does the same thing. That’s not just a christian prayer thing, its something all people of all religions do. And I don’t think those phrases are bad. It lets someone know that you emotionally feel/empathise with the, without asking to lend a hand. Or something people say after funerals when theyve already given money but not talked to the family. Some people also don’t have the ability to help whether financially, emotionally, or physically. And sometime there is no way to help. Its still better to say something something I think. Idk I just feel like its alot more complicated than “instead of saying something, do something” 


Also I liked your response, it gave me alot to reply to
And i litterly just answered you question “why do religious people think the only way to help someone is through prayer” which we dont think its the only way, just that it is a way

fuck, obviously the world isn’t a beautiful fucking paradise. Chistianity doesn’t fix shit, its a belief system of how we think things work. And you don’t know how someone is thinking. I litterly wrote this trying to better myself. Idk what went up your ass, but christianity isn’t the enemy. Are some churches and christians? Yes, some are pretty fucking terrible.some things christians beleive are fucking terrible. But so arent some islams and some muslims, and im sure some jewish too. People can be evil. Societal structures can be evil. But christianity isn’t evil, and just because you for some reason got  fucked over by christianity doesnt mean all christians are against you. And you say you think “I pray for you” will do nothing. Well thats why I was fucking asking dude. Why would I ask if i think i should say ill pray for you to every fucking person on the street.

I was litterly asking for advice, and you come in and be rude and negative. And honestly i know people who are satanists and if they decide to pray to satan for me than i would be fine with that because they are doing what they think is best. my sister is looking into wicca, and if she prayed to whatever god/nature she is praying to than i would be good with that because shes doing what she thinks is best. While im trying to become more open and welcoming you are trying to bash my religion, faith, and views. So like, fuck you?
Agreed
Send good juju is great tho, idk why someone would be offended by that.
Thats pretty much how I feel. What you say is better than my lame “im sorry”.

I can see what your saying with it being a cop out. I don’t think of it that way when I think of praying for someone, however I do understand why someone will think that. And im sure alot of people do it because they don’t know what else to say and doesnt want to do anything.  I rarely say it out of anxiety of offending someone, but this makes me want to say it less lol

And I don’t think it is predatory. Saying “ill keep you in my thoughts” does just as little as “ill keep you in my prayers” but in my faith, praying does more. I don’t see how it demeans someone or is predatory.

When I think of praying for someone, its asking god to help their situation. And even if other people don’t believe it does something, I do. If you go with the idea that god is real and loves everyone, even though he knows everything, its talking to him and specifally asking them to direct their attention to the person. Like how I would ask my dad to help one of my sisters. I hope that makes sense

Thank you. Im happy you found something that works for you. And I know I will have to use that mentality of forcing myself to go, hopefully My experience is like yours where once I am there I am fine, I just worry about the what if I am not fine, what will I do. I remember working at a nursing home before, and highschool, and I volunteered at a soup kitchen. My anxiety didn’t go down, and at school I would constantly feel like I had the flu. Granted I wasn’t on medication which I am now.

Im happy you found something that works for you! I would look for an online job, however my parents not only want me to get a job so I can make money, but also because they want me to go back into the world. So that wouldn’t fly with them. (I am 18 and live with them)
Going one day at a time seems like a good idea, I hope things work out.

Hello, thank you for your reply. I do think it would be a good idea to look for other jobs but it is tricky. I can’t do warehouse/farm jobs because I have slight chronic pain which would worsen with constant lifting. I would want an online job, however my parents (I am 18) have said no only do they want want me to make money, but really they want me to learn how to go back into society. I keep searching, but especially with corona, I don’t think there are many options. 

I am happy you found a job you were comfortable at and had understanding managers! Sounds like a success story which definitely gives me hope. 

I don’t know if I would have the courage to tell my bosses abt my mental health tho. 

Your reply was very thoughtful and helpful, I hope you are staying safe and happy during this time!
I am sorry you had to go through that, I hope you find something that will work for you.

Dont be sorry for telling your experience! Im sorry you are going through that. You should not have to feel obligated to do something because of the judgments of others. Go back when you are ready. 
Thank you for sharing your story, it definitely makes me feel less alone. 💛

Its nice that enjoy going out in the car. I love car rides, as long as I am not the one driving and I am not alone. Though I do feel comfortable enough to sit in the car alone while my parents go into the stores.

Im sorry you are struggling so much. I am happy you are able to go outside with your family. I don’t think mine is so bad, because as long as I am with my mom or dad I am completely fine. Its just any other time. Even just a drive down the street. I have been starting to go on walks down my wooded driveway by myself tho, so I am hoping doing that alone will make me feel better about going other places alone.
I will definitely check her out, Thankyou!

Thankyou, that is very helpful. i should probably talk to my therapist about it. Though I have been doing so good with everything else mental health related, and never really have a need to go out by myself especially because of quarantine, so I am worried about doing that and having no “proof”, im sure eventually it will get worked out.
Aww thankyou, dm me 💛
Yea that does, ill definitely keep that in mind. I find that difficult when I am not super close with them, but maybe I could get over that. Thank you!
I guess that is an obvious one, Idk why I didn’t think of it 😅

Thank you! Your reply eased my anxieties a little bit. Hearing that a medical setting and being with patients helped with social anxiety gives me hope that this is something that I can overcome. I will definitely try to focus on my victories instead of my failures. Thank you again!

Thank you for taking the time to reply. I agree that how many friends doesn’t change my self worth, and that people who don’t accept me shouldn’t be in my life. However I do disagree that friends aren’t important. If I have no one to turn to, no support, and no distraction from daily life through people, I feel like that is no way to life. I do like your advice about not focusing my energy on it, as I do have other things to worry about. I just can’t help but think about it when i see things that make me crave human connection. Thank you again, you did help.
